examples.text: Le vaisseau que je montois ayant été totalement désemparé, il fallut entrer dans la rivière de Syriam pour le remâter.
examples.translation: The ship that I boarded having been totally disabled, it was necessary to enter the Syriam river to remast it.
examples.english: The ship that I boarded having been totally disabled, it was necessary to enter the Syriam river to remast it.

examples.text: Il remâtera ses vaisseaux avec les mâtures des frégates, ses frégates avec les mâtures des transports, et ceux-ci, à leur tour, avec des agrès de fortune.
examples.translation: He will remast his ships with the masts of the frigates, his frigates with the masts of the transporters, and these, in turn, with makeshift gear.
examples.english: He will remast his ships with the masts of the frigates, his frigates with the masts of the transporters, and these, in turn, with makeshift gear.

examples.text: En trente-six heures, le navire est remâté, regréé et déchargé de tout poids inutile.
examples.translation: In thirty-six hours, the ship is remasted, rerigged and unloaded of any unnecessary weight.
examples.english: In thirty-six hours, the ship is remasted, rerigged and unloaded of any unnecessary weight.
